name: Colca Canyon trek to the Sangalle oasis
why: Down 1,100 m into one of the deepest canyons on Earth, a night by the pools of a palm oasis, and back up at dawn.
book: The Colca tourist ticket (boleto turístico), checked on the road. Lodges in San Juan de Chuccho and Sangalle need no booking out of July-August.
water: Buy at the lodges at the bottom.
dangers: The climb out from Sangalle: 1,100 m in 3-4 hours, start before 05:00 to beat the sun.

points.name: Mirador San Miguel, Cabanaconde
points.note: Day 1: the descent starts at the canyon rim, 3,290 m.

points.name: Colca river bridge
points.note: The bottom of the canyon, about 2,200 m: cross the river.

points.name: San Juan de Chuccho
points.note: A village of fruit trees; lunch, then along the canyon to the oasis.

points.name: Sangalle oasis
points.note: Night by the pools; day 2 climbs straight back to Cabanaconde.
